_comment: Commit SHAs every citation link is pinned to. Bump a SHA here, run scripts/verify-citations.py --repin to rewrite the links, then re-run the verifier. Never point citation links at a mutable branch: line numbers drift silently and the citations are the credibility of this whole site.
